title: Proportion of schools offering basic services, by type of service
graph_title: Proportion of schools offering basic services, by type of service
national_indicator_avalable: Proportion of schools offering basic services, by type of service
national_indicator_description: This indicator measures the proportion of schools by level of education (pre-primary, primary, secondary, and vocational secondary) with (a) connection to on-grid electricity; (b) internet connectivity; (c) computers; (d) handwashing facilities; (e) adapted infrastructure for learners with disability; (f) safe drinking water; and (g) single sex toilets.
computation_definitions: The number of schools in each level of education which offer the service in question is divided by the total number of schools in that level of education. Secondary schools are divided between general and professional secondary schools (labeled as "Secondary education") and TVET L1-L5 level schools (labeled as "Vocational secondary education").
computation_calculations: (Number of schools offering the service) / (Total number of schools) * 100
other_info: Additional information on school services and equipment is available in the linked data source, including information on solar power, electric power generators, biogas systems, tap water, rainwater harvesting, school feeding, and other services. Alternative measures of the proportion of schools offering basic services are available from the [SDG 4 Country Profile for Rwanda](https://download.uis.unesco.org/SDG4/SDG4-Profile-Rwanda.pdf) compiled by UNESCO.
comments_limitations: The definitions of some services may differ somewhat from those provided in the global metadata. Lower and upper secondary education levels are not differentiated. Where figures for a given year conflict, the most recent figures have been used.
indicator_definition: The percentage of schools by level of education (primary, lower secondary and upper secondary education) with access to the given facility or service (basic handwashing facilities; computers for pedagogical purposes; electricity; basic drinking water; internet for pedagogical purposes; single-sex basic sanitation; adapted infrastructure and materials for students with disabilities).
un_custodian_agency: United Nations Education and Scientific Cultural Organisation - Institute for Statistics (UNESCO-UIS)
